description: Chess Position Analyzer turns ChatGPT into a chess study partner. Load any position from FEN or start fresh, then drag pieces on the board to set up puzzles, try hypotheticals, or follow a line. Ask questions like "what's White's plan?", "why is this move better?", or "what changes if the rook were on d1?" — and get answers grounded in the exact position in front of you..
